```yaml
name: JavaDoc Snippet Extraction & Validation

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

jobs:
  check:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    outputs:
      only_snippet_tools: ${{ steps.check.outputs.only_snippet_tools }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check for non‑script changes
        id: check
        run: |
          # Determine base commit for diff
          if [[ "${{ github.event_name }}" == "pull_request" ]]; then
            base_sha=${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          else
            base_sha=${{ github.sha }}^
          fi
          changed=$(git diff --name-only "$base_sha" "${{ github.sha }}")
          for file in $changed; do
            if [[ ! $file =~ ^scripts/.*$ && ! $file =~ ^\.github/workflows/java-snippet-validation\.yml$ ]]; then
              echo "Non‑script change detected: $file"
              echo "only_snippet_tools=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
              exit 0
            fi
          done
          echo "only_snippet_tools=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

  validate:
    needs: check
    if: needs.check.outputs.only_snippet_tools == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Set up Java
        uses: actions/setup-java@v4
        with:
          distribution: temurin
          java-version: 17

      - name: Extract JavaDoc snippets
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh
          scripts/extract-javadoc-java-snippets.sh > snippets.jsonl

      - name: Validate snippets
        run: |
          chmod +x scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh
          set -e
          while IFS= read -r line; do
            echo "$line" | scripts/java-snippet-to-playground-uri.sh
          done < snippets.jsonl
```
